sasha_cs: Heads-up: TransectAI QBR prep Friday. Onboarding at 70% but renewal flagged. Primary concern: token spike after daily ingest. Need a short cost/playbook snippet for the deck.
tony_se: I can grab numbers now. Last 30d tokens = 9.6M; big spike on 2026-03-10 during nightly ingest job. Embeds ~52% of tokens.
hana_pm: Product note: they enabled long-context Q&A + nightly vector refresh. Agree we should keep functionality but offer containment options.
diego_finops: Recommend three mitigation levers: reduce embed model size, throttle refresh frequency, enable prefix KV cache. I'll draft 3 scenario estimates.
alert-bot: Billing alert: TransectAI (acct 9910) projected 30d spend = $9,500; threshold = $8,000; notification method = webhook only.
sasha_cs: Please put TL;DR numbers we can paste on slide + one-sentence customer ask.
tony_se: Quick raw: `baseline: 9.6M tokens -> $9.5k`; `embed->em-lite: 7.2M -> $7.1k`; `throttle refresh 7d->14d: 6.0M -> $5.9k`; `both: 4.1M -> $4.0k`. Backfill window noted: 03-10 01:40-02:20 UTC.
diego_finops: I re-enabled daily budget emails for acct 9910 and set soft_limit=$7,500; hard_throttle at 120% projected daily. Also added an ask: CS to confirm retention window for KV caching.
hana_pm: I'll mock a one-slide tradeoff: feature vs cost with those four rows. Also will capture their hallucination note on very long docs and add a small eval plan.
sasha_cs: Awesome. Action items: 1) Tony drop the config diffs (batch_size, refresh cadence, embed model) here, 2) Diego confirm alert shows to customer, 3) Hana add the eval line to appendix. Sync quick at 9:30am PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
